description: Build the interactive price chart using Recharts and proxy data
steps: Create PriceChart component in web/src/components/event/price-chart.tsx
Use useTimeseries hook from Sprint 00 for data fetching
Implement line chart as default view using Recharts
Add area fill under the line with gradient
Show price on Y-axis formatted as percentage (0-100%)
Show time on X-axis with appropriate formatting per range
Add crosshair with tooltip showing exact price/time

description: Build time range selection for price chart
steps: Create TimeRangeSelector component with button group
Options: 1H, 6H, 1D, 1W, 1M, ALL
Map ranges to Polymarket intervals (1m, 5m, 1h, 1d)
Highlight selected range with accent color
Refetch data when range changes via useTimeseries
Show loading indicator during range change
Persist selected range in URL query param

description: Create custom tooltip for price chart
steps: Create ChartTooltip component with styled container
Display: Date/Time, Price (cents and percentage)
Show Open, High, Low, Close from proxy response
Display volume for the period
Show price change from previous period
Position tooltip to avoid chart edges
notes: OHLC and volume data not available from Polymarket timeseries API (returns only {t, p} points). Tooltip shows price change from previous data point as alternative.

description: Add volume bars overlay to price chart
steps: Add bar chart layer for volume data from proxy
Position volume bars at bottom 20% of chart
Use semi-transparent bars to not obscure price line
Color bars based on price direction (green up, red down)
Scale volume axis independently from price
Include volume in tooltip
notes: BLOCKED: Polymarket CLOB /prices-history API only returns {t, p} (timestamp, price) data points. No per-period volume data is available. The Gamma API provides aggregate volume metrics (volume24hr, volume1wk, etc.) but not time-bucketed volume suitable for chart overlay. Implementing this would require aggregating from individual trades (expensive API calls) which is outside the scope of this task. This task can be unblocked if Polymarket adds OHLCV data to their timeseries endpoint.

description: Build order book visualization using proxy data
steps: Create OrderBook component in web/src/components/event/order-book.tsx
Use useOrderbook hook from Sprint 00 for real-time data
Create horizontal bid/ask depth bars
Show best bid and best ask prices prominently
Display spread in cents and percentage
Use green for bids, red for asks
Show configurable number of levels (default 5)

description: Create depth visualization for order book
steps: Create cumulative depth bars showing total size at each level
Scale bar width relative to largest size
Add hover state showing exact price and size
Animate bar changes on data updates
Show mid-price line between bids and asks
notes: Cumulative depth bars and scaled bar widths were already implemented in orderbook_component. This task added: (1) OrderLevelTooltip component with detailed hover state showing side, price (cents and %), size, cumulative size, and notional value; (2) CSS transitions for animated bar width changes (duration-300 ease-out); (3) Visual mid-price line with gradient from green through indigo to red, plus diamond indicator at mid-price; (4) Enhanced spread row with centered bid/mid/ask display in pill container.

description: Handle loading and empty states for charts
steps: Create ChartLoadingSkeleton with animated placeholder
Show 'No price data available' for empty data
Add retry button on chart data fetch failure
Maintain chart dimensions during loading to prevent layout shift
Show subtle loading indicator on range change (not full skeleton)

description: Handle loading and error states for order book
steps: Create OrderBookSkeleton with animated placeholder
Show 'Order book unavailable' on proxy failure
Add auto-retry with exponential backoff
Show stale indicator if data is older than 10s
Configure refetch interval (5s default)
notes: OrderBookSkeleton and error states were implemented in orderbook_component. This task added: (1) exponential backoff retry via retryDelay in useOrderbook hook (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s max), (2) OrderBookStaleIndicator component showing amber warning when data >10s old, (3) configurable retryCount parameter.
